item_short_desc: The GI Mosquito Net is brand new government issue insect netting. The mosquito netting features reinforced edges and corners with ties with an ultra fine "no-see-um" mesh fabric that will keep the bugs out. Perfect for camping and the outdoors the military issue mosquito netting fits over cots and pup tents, it can also double as a hunting blind for concealment.
